name: Vermont

fees.note: One $48 single-trip permit covers overweight, width, indivisible overlength and height; valid 7 business days. If the load is also overweight the same $48 is shown on the overweight line instead.
Single-trip permit $48 (one permit covers weight and dimensions).
Engineering inspection fee: 150,000-200,000 lb $2,000; 200,001-250,000 lb $5,000; over 250,000 lb $10,000. Must be completed before permit issue (up to 10 working days); valid 6 months for the route.

Engineering inspection (width 15 ft or more): $800 up to 8 h, +$60/h beyond. Under 150,000 lb only (heavier loads priced on the weight line). One inspection per move (grouped across width/length/height).
Engineering inspection (length over 100 ft): $800 up to 8 h, +$60/h beyond. One inspection per move (grouped across width/length/height).
Engineering inspection (height over 14 ft): $800 up to 8 h, +$60/h beyond. One inspection per move (grouped across width/length/height).

restrictions.text: Daylight only: 30 min before sunrise to 30 min after sunset (overweight-only loads that keep up with traffic are not restricted). Heavy-traffic routes may be further restricted by hour/day.
No permits for state-highway movement over 12 ft wide, over 100 ft long or over 108,000 lb on Saturday, Sunday, or New Year's, Memorial Day, July 4, Labor Day, Thanksgiving, Christmas.
